title: Listening Drill — Night photography
description: Booking dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Night photography
sections.transcript:
CALLER: Hello. I'd like to book a night photography walk. I saw an older notice saying that bookings opened on Friday morning. Is that still right?

ADVISER: That notice is out of date. Bookings open on Saturday this time. If you collect your booking pack in person, go to the station kiosk. The reception desk in the main building won't have the packs.

CALLER: How much is the booking? I can pay online if that saves time.

ADVISER: The total is sixteen pounds. Pay once you've checked the date. Then contact Leah if you haven't received confirmation within two working days.

CALLER: Thanks. Is there anything else I should know before I arrive?

ADVISER: One practical detail: bring a charged battery.
